The task was to search ArXiv by title for “Poly encoder” and check whether the articles in the search results provide HTML access.

The result response states that the ArXiv title search returned 4 results and that all 4 articles had “HTML (experimental)” access links which were successfully opened. It also lists each article with its corresponding HTML URL. The provided screenshot shows one of the listed papers on its ArXiv abstract page, and the right-side “Access Paper” panel clearly includes an “HTML (experimental)” link, supporting the claim at least for that article.

Although the screenshot only directly verifies one of the four papers, the textual result provides the remaining checked information, and there is no contradiction between the screenshot and response.

Verdict: SUCCESS
